currentUserGoal: Fix grass touching SFX being completely inaudible/nonfunctional on mobile. User clarified this is not a background-mix issue; the grass touch SFX appears not to play at all.
changesMade: Added a tiny generated HTMLAudioElement fallback for grass touch sounds so mobile browsers have a second playback path if the WebAudio SFX context is not producing audible output.
Kept the existing WebAudio synthesized grass touch path, but now normal running grass touches also trigger the fallback path.
Avoided double fallback playback when WebAudio resumes asynchronously after a suspended mobile audio context.
Added fallback audio pooling to allow repeated taps without waiting for one HTML audio element to finish.
Kept fallback playback tied to SFX volume and grass-touch rate limiting.
Made the WebAudio touch crunch brighter and more phone-speaker-forward with short high-pass crunch transients.
Increased music ducking only around grass-touch SFX so the fixed tap sound has room when music is enabled.
verification: Browser perf harness at 390x844, ?perfHarness&tiles=1200: status complete, visibleTiles 132-143 during active phases, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, maxFrameDeltaMs 12ms or lower, frameSpikes 0, displayObjects 846-958, activeTweens 11-21, tapBurst hotspot stayed in normal frame/update/UI/combo ranges.
